newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil names new exploration chief.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil names new exploration chief.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said Friday Paul L. Keyes has been named senior vice president - exploration of Pennzoil Exploration and Production Co, succeeding David Henderson, who has resigned to pursue another opportunity.
Keyes most recently served as senior advisor to the Pennzoil exploration unit and is a former senior manager at Exxon Corp.
Since joining Pennzoil in 1993, the company said, Keyes has been a member of the portfolio management team responsible for approving and recommending Pepco's annual capital investment program.

In addition, he was an important participant in the formulation of the company's key strategic initiatives, including the development and implementation of the reengineering plan, which resulted in a realignment of Pepco's investment programs.
